reviews.author: Elena M.
reviews.text: We came almost every evening during our stay in Baku. Fresh food, warm service, and a terrace that feels protected from the square noise — truly excellent.

reviews.author: James K.
reviews.text: Best introduction to Azerbaijani cuisine. The kutabs, thyme tea, and tomato salad were unforgettable. Clean, cozy, and beautifully located.

reviews.author: Aysel R.
reviews.text: Delicious food with fair prices and polite staff. The mixed grill and plov are must-orders. Perfect for guests visiting Baku.

reviews.author: Marco D.
reviews.text: Central location, elegant interior, and a large terrace. Service was attentive and the national dishes were the highlight of our trip.

reviews.author: Nina S.
reviews.text: Breakfast was outstanding — generous platter, excellent tea, and a calm morning atmosphere. Highly recommend reserving a terrace table.

reviews.author: Orkhan H.
reviews.text: Stylish setting with carpets, soft lighting, and live-feeling hospitality. Ideal for family dinners and celebrations.
